guardrail_rule_tested: verify_label: quote must exist in the source; no outside knowledge

guardrail_rule_tested: verify_label: exact substring match

expected_with_guardrails: verify_label FAILS (quote not in passage) → sent to human review
typical_failure_without_guardrails: Label accepted and scored

guardrail_rule_tested: verify_label: exact substring match (numbers included)
